Count Agreement Between Overlapping Mates

Source: R/duckhts.R
rduckhts_bam_mate_overlap_counts.Rd

Compares read 1 and read 2 of one fragment at each reference position where both mates have an aligned base, and counts the pairs of base qualities and bases. A real allele sits on the molecule and both mates show it; a sequencing error usually shows in one mate only. So the disagreement rate is about twice the instrument error rate, with no reference, mask or contamination model. Errors made before sequencing, such as PCR or damage errors, show in both mates and are not seen.

Usage

rduckhts_bam_mate_overlap_counts(
  con,
  path,
  region = NULL,
  index_path = NULL,
  reference = NULL,
  reference_index_path = NULL,
  min_mapq = 20,
  require_flags = 0,
  exclude_flags = 3844,
  max_pending = 1e+06
)

Arguments

con

A DuckDB connection with DuckHTS loaded

path

Path to the paired-end SAM, BAM or CRAM file

region

Optional comma-separated contigs or intervals. It needs an alignment index and selects alignments by overlap; a pair counts only when both mates are selected

index_path

Optional explicit alignment index path

reference

Optional indexed reference FASTA. Required for CRAM; it is otherwise used only to resolve read bases stored as `=`

reference_index_path

Optional explicit FASTA index path

min_mapq

Minimum mapping quality, 0 to 255

require_flags, exclude_flags

SAM flag masks that both mates must pass. The default `exclude_flags` leaves out unmapped, secondary, failed, duplicate and supplementary alignments

max_pending

Most mates held at once while they wait for their mate, 1 to 100000000

Value

A data frame with `read1_quality` and `read2_quality` (`NA` when the read stores no qualities), `read1_base` and `read2_base` on the forward strand of the reference, and `positions`. Read 1 is the mate with flag 0x40. Rows with different bases are the disagreements.

Details

Alignments must be in coordinate order. The first mate of a pair is held until its mate arrives; more than `max_pending` mates held at once is an error.

Examples

library(DBI)
library(duckdb)

con <- rduckhts_connect()
bam <- system.file("extdata", "empty-tids.bam", package = "Rduckhts")
counts <- rduckhts_bam_mate_overlap_counts(con, bam)
sum(counts$positions[counts$read1_base != counts$read2_base]) / sum(counts$positions)
#> [1] 0.004428698
dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)
